stem: The graph of the function \(y = f(x)\) is shown. Which of the following could define \(f\)?
solution: Check each choice at the three labeled points \((0, 1)\), \((1, 4)\), and \((2, 10)\).
Each other choice misses at least one of the points, so \(f(x) = 3(2)^{x} - 2\).

explanation.B: Incorrect. This linear function passes through \((0, 1)\) and \((1, 4)\), but \(3(2) + 1 = 7\), not 10. The graph is curved, not a line.
explanation.C: Correct. \(3(1) - 2 = 1\), \(3(2) - 2 = 4\), and \(3(4) - 2 = 10\), so all three points lie on this graph.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This function passes through \((0, 1)\) and \((1, 4)\), but \(4^{2} = 16\), not 10.
